BIO

I am currently a software engineer working with Block Inc. Previously I worked for Microsoft in Redmond, Washington. Prior to that I worked with Comcast in Philadelphia for 4 years. I started my undergraduate studies in Computer Science at the Delaware County Community College and completed it at Drexel University. I completed this in tandem with a Minor in Business Administration. In 2019 I completed my graduate studies in Cybersecurity.
